messages:
maya (CSM): Heads-up — Meridian QBR Thurs 3pm PT. Need cost run, onboarding status, renewal flags. Can we assemble by EOD Wed? :calendar:
jonathan (AM): On it. I'll drop a 90/30/7-day token burn forecast. Need the last 7-day top embedding routes to inform the tail spikes. @rachel (FinOps) can you confirm their retainer/cushion?
rachel (FinOps): Current retainer cushion ~ $12k. At present run-rate we'd hit soft threshold in ~9 days if nightly batches keep spiking. alert thresholds: `warn=80%`, `soft=95%`, `hard=100%`.
oliver (CS): Onboarding note — they've enabled the batch-embedding pipeline; great adoption but nightly batches cause token surges. Recommend prefix caching + per-job throttles. I'll produce a brief enablement checklist.
jonathan (AM): For renewal positioning — if we show a cost-lower path (quantized model + batching) we can present ~20% cost reduction in the QBR. Need a one-slide before/after with assumptions.
maya (CSM): Can we set a temporary quota override so their UI doesn't hit hard-limit during QBR prep? ops-bot, can you create a one-week soft-limit at 150%?
ops-bot: @maya created quota override: Meridian — soft_limit=150% until 2024-05-03T23:59:59Z. Audit ID: qbrop-3289 :white_check_mark:
rachel (FinOps): I'll prepare a conservative 90/30/7-day forecast table and add sensitivity lines for quantization and reduced batch frequency. Will upload to `qbr/meridian` folder and tag the deck.
oliver (CS): Also capture this piece of feedback: customer reported embedding latency variability on large batches. Action item: schedule 30-min tech deep-dive during QBR to demo caching + KV reuse.
maya (CSM): Great — packing list: forecast (jonathan), budget calc + sensitivity (rachel), enablement checklist + tech deep-dive (oliver). Drop materials in `qbr/meridian` and ping me when done. :thumbsup:
